name: update-changelog
script:
cd /workspace && git log --pretty=format:"- %s (%h)" $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 HEAD^)..HEAD > /tmp/changelog_new.md && sed -i '1i## [$VERSION] - $(date +%Y-%m-%d)' /tmp/changelog_new.md && sed -i '2i
### Added' /tmp/changelog_new.md && sed -i '/## \[Unreleased\]/r /tmp/changelog_new.md' CHANGELOG.md && sed -i '/## \[Unreleased\]/a
### Added
- (add items here)' CHANGELOG.md && echo "CHANGELOG.md updated for $VERSION"
